Container.Name: ASATheIsland
Container.Overview: ARK: Survival Ascended dedicated server (Steam app 2430930) running under Wine 11 on Debian. SteamCMD installs/updates the server on every start.[br][br] One container per map, all sharing the same Server Files folder (one download per game update) and cluster. Stop all ASA servers before restarting for a game update, then start them one at a time.[br][br] Ports: game 7760+n / query 27000+n, one slot per map (see Mods.txt on the Swap share). Set both port mappings AND -port/-QueryPort in Extra Game Parameters.[br][br] Host requirements:[br] - vm.max_map_count at least 256000; 1048576 recommended (the container sleeps and logs instructions if it is below 256000).[br] - NTSYNC=1: Unraid 7.3+ (kernel 6.14+) with 'modprobe ntsync' in /boot/config/go. Privileged mode exposes /dev/ntsync, so no --device flag is needed; if the module is missing the server falls back to ESync/FSync instead of failing to start.[br][br] Shared memory: Extra Parameters sets '--shm-size=4g' (Docker's default /dev/shm is only 64 MB), part of the fix attempt for idle crashes on newer maps. The start script sets the stack size itself (ulimit -s 8192).[br][br] Stopping: the container saves the world over RCON (SaveWorld, then DoExit) before it exits. RCON listens only inside the container on RCON Port; never map that port. '--stop-timeout=60' gives the save up to 60 s before Docker force-kills it (Docker's default is 10 s).[br][br] Rollback: CI keeps the image it replaces as :previous and also pushes dated and per-commit tags. Run the 'Retag image' GitHub workflow (asa-wine, previous or a date tag -> latest) and Force Update, or change Repository to e.g. caaarrrlll/asa-wine:2026-11-17 and switch back to :latest later.[br][br] WARNING: DEBUG=1 prints passwords to the container log.
Container.Requires: Host vm.max_map_count of at least 256000 (1048576 recommended); kernel 6.14+ with the ntsync module loaded for NTSYNC=1.

Config.Name: SteamCMD
Config.Description: SteamCMD install location (shared by all ASA servers).

Config.Name: Server Files
Config.Description: ARK server files, Wine prefix (WINE64), saves, logs and cluster data. Shared by all ASA servers.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Game port, 7760+n (also -port= in Extra Game Parameters).

Config.Name: Query Port
Config.Description: Query port, 27000+n (also -QueryPort= in Extra Game Parameters).

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Session name shown in the server browser. Spaces are fine; '?' is not.

Config.Name: Map
Config.Description: Map to load, e.g. TheIsland_WP, TheCenter_WP, ScorchedEarth_WP, ScorchedEarthRM_WP, Aberration_WP, Extinction_WP, Ragnarok_WP, Valguero_WP, LostColony_WP, Astraeos_WP, Amissa_WP, Bjarnheim_WP, Genesis_WP.

Config.Name: Server Password
Config.Description: Password players need to join. No '?'.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Server admin password. No '?'.

Config.Name: Extra Game Parameters
Config.Description: ARK server flags only. -port / -QueryPort must match the port mappings above. Do not add -LOG=, -mods=, -clusterid= or -GBUsageToForceRestart= here; use their own fields.

Config.Name: Mod IDs
Config.Description: Comma-separated CurseForge mod IDs (passed as -mods=). Default = the cluster's base mods; map-specific lists are in Mods.txt on the Swap share.

Config.Name: Cluster ID
Config.Description: Cluster ID (passed as -clusterid=, with -clusterDirOverride=/serverdata/serverfiles/clusterfiles inside the shared server files). Same on every server in the cluster; empty = standalone.

Config.Name: Force Restart Usage
Config.Description: Passed as -GBUsageToForceRestart=. 0 disables the forced restart.

Config.Name: Autosave (minutes)
Config.Description: World autosave interval in minutes (passed as ?AutoSavePeriodMinutes=, overrides GameUserSettings.ini). Also the most progress a crash can lose.

Config.Name: RCON Port
Config.Description: RCON port INSIDE the container (passed as ?RCONEnabled=True?RCONPort=). Used to save the world on stop. Do NOT add a port mapping for it; every server can use the same value.

Config.Name: Log Prefix
Config.Description: Prefix for this server's log file: ShooterGame/Saved/Logs/<prefix>-ShooterGame.log (passed to the server as -LOG=). Spaces at the start/end are trimmed; leave blank to use the map name, e.g. TheIsland_WP-ShooterGame.log. Set it only when two servers run the same map.

Config.Name: NTSYNC
Config.Description: 1 = use the ntsync driver for Wine (needs /dev/ntsync on the host; privileged mode exposes it). Falls back to ESync/FSync with a log warning if it is missing.

Config.Name: Validate
Config.Description: true = validate the game files with SteamCMD on start (slow; the install is shared, so only with all other ASA servers stopped).

Config.Name: Debug
Config.Description: 1 = print troubleshooting info, INCLUDING PASSWORDS, to the log.

Config.Name: Game ID
Config.Description: Steam app ID. Use '2430930 -beta BRANCH' for a beta branch.

Config.Name: Steam Username
Config.Description: Leave empty for anonymous login.

Config.Name: Steam Password
Config.Description: Leave empty for anonymous login.

Config.Name: UID
Config.Description: User ID the server runs as.

Config.Name: GID
Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: umask for files the server creates. 000 = Unraid style (folders 777, files 666).
